root_cause_analysis.symptom: All drag-and-drop slot interactions produce v2 day files with slots at wrong JSON path; budget always returns 0; stage transitions unconstrained; export endpoints fail on import
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: save.py and budget.py were written targeting a flat day-dict shape (legacy v1 pattern) that was superseded by the v2 schema placing named slots under day['slots']. The state machine module exists but was never wired into the save handler. The two exporter packages were added to the codebase without being added to requirements.txt.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — schema mismatch introduced when v2 server handlers were written; not a regression from a single commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: v2 schema design placed slots under a 'slots' sub-object; server handlers were written or copied from pre-v2 code without updating the slot access pattern
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: schemas/v2/day.schema.json line 107 has additionalProperties:false at root — any key not in the schema's 'properties' causes validation failure; slot keys written at root are rejected and slot keys read from root return empty dict, yielding zero costs
root_cause_analysis.timeline: N/A — fresh v2 server implementation, not a regression from working state

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Scope confirmed minimal. Key refinements: (1) accommodation stays top-level — v2 schema only places the 6 named activity slots under day['slots']; budget.py:128 day.get('accommodation', {}) is correct and must not change. (2) Bug 4 HTTP 409: typed exception (StateMachineError) caught in serve-trip.py is the cleaner approach; inline stage_error field is worse because the HTTP layer would not suppress the write. (3) requirements.txt pinned == style preferred (reportlab==4.5.1, icalendar==7.1.0). (4) tests/server/conftest.py _build_day() fixture update is in scope. (5) Scope creep to reject: rewriting legacy/top-level slot readers, moving accommodation under slots, route-cache invalidation, broad data migration.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Added explicit constraint that accommodation stays top-level; changed requirements.txt versions to pinned == values matching latest; added conftest.py to affected files list; added explicit AC7 for fixture update; added pre_existing_guard for budget.py:128 accommodation path
